第25章 心心同学有两个妈妈吗（第1页）
见他看向浴室那边，封景心说道：“是妈妈在里面洗澡。”
又问：“是你让你妈妈来这边洗澡的？”
“没有啊，是妈妈自己拿衣服过来的。”
封庭深没有再问了，陪她说了两句话，让她早点休息后，就转身离开了。
容辞在浴室里有听到动静，知道是封庭深来了，但她没听清他们说了什么。
封景心病还没全好，吃了药又容易犯困，容辞眼看时间也不早了，洗完澡后，就陪着她在床上躺下了。
封景心窝到了她怀里，在她肩窝蹭着：“妈妈好香好软啊。”
不过，知道容辞不喜欢林芜，她没说出来。
封景心生病之后，就特别爱踢被子。
可能是担心已经成了习惯，容辞还是像以前照顾封景心那样，一个晚上醒了好几次，在一次次给她盖好被子，不会着凉后，才会安心的继续睡去。
当天晚上，容辞没睡好，却天刚亮就醒了。
封景心还在睡，容辞轻手轻脚的起了床，到窗边看了眼，发现封庭深果然正在楼下跑步。
他一般会跑一个小时左右才会回来。
容辞洗漱后，找了身衣服换上，才下楼进去厨房做早餐。
半个小时后，把剩下的工作交给了刘婶，确定封景心没有复烧后，她上楼拿上包包和车钥匙，就离开了。
找了一圈没找到容辞，问道：“妈妈呢？”
刘婶笑道：“但太太出门前，已经给你准备好了早餐。

她病还没全好，但精神不错，也饿了，洗漱后就下楼去吃早餐。
没看到容辞，他顿了下，也问刘婶：“太太呢？”
容辞回到家，吃了点东西，收拾好电脑和一些必需品，刚准备去公司报到，门铃就响了起来。
容辞看了眼门口的监控，是邻居方太太和她女儿甜甜。
方太太一脸焦急：“容小姐，甜甜她奶奶生病了，我得送她去一趟医院，能麻烦你帮我送甜甜去学校吗？”
封景心和甜甜他们上的幼儿园和公司正好顺路，容辞就同意了。
二十分钟后，抵达幼儿园门口附近，容辞正想找位置停车，就看到了封庭深，林芜和封景心三人。
封景心看着精神不错，她和林芜手牵手，走路时一蹦一跳的，看着非常开心。
至于封庭深，他站在林芜旁边，体贴地为林芜和封景心隔绝车流和人流。
甜甜也看到了封景心：“容姐姐，是心心同学！”
“那个牵着心心同学的漂亮阿姨是谁啊？也是心心同学的妈妈吗？心心同学有两个妈妈吗？”

Chapter 25 Does Xinxin have two mothers (Page 1)
Seeing him looking towards the bathroom, Feng Jingxin said, "It's mom taking a bath in there."
Then he asked: "Did you ask your mother to come here to take a bath?"
"No, mom brought the clothes herself."
Feng Tingshen didn't ask any more questions. He said a few words to her and asked her to rest early, then turned and left.
Rong Ci heard movement in the bathroom and knew that Feng Tingshen was here, but she didn't hear what they said clearly.
Feng Jing's heart disease was not completely cured, and he became sleepy easily after taking medicine. Rong Ci saw that it was getting late, so after taking a bath, he lay down on the bed with her.
Feng Jing's heart felt in her arms, rubbing against her shoulder: "Mom, it smells so good and soft."
However, knowing that Rong Ci didn't like Lin Wu, she didn't say it out loud.
After Feng Jingxin fell ill, he especially loved to kick the quilt.
Maybe it was because worry had become a habit, but Rong Ci still took care of Feng Jingxin as he did before, waking up several times a night, and only after covering her with a quilt again and again so that she wouldn't catch a cold would he continue to sleep peacefully.
That night, Rong Ci didn't sleep well, but woke up at dawn.
Feng Jingxin was still sleeping, and Rong Ci got up gently. He took a look at the window and found that Feng Tingshen was running downstairs.
He usually runs for about an hour before coming back.
After Rong Ci washed up, he found some clothes and changed into some clothes before going downstairs and going into the kitchen to make breakfast.
Half an hour later, she handed over the remaining work to Aunt Liu. After making sure that Feng Jingxin had no recurrence of fever, she went upstairs to get her bag and car keys, and left.
After searching around but not finding Rong Ci, he asked, "Where's mom?"
Aunt Liu smiled and said, "But before Madam went out, she had already prepared breakfast for you.
She was not fully recovered from her illness, but she was in good spirits and hungry. After washing, she went downstairs to have breakfast.
Not seeing Rong Ci, he paused and asked Aunt Liu: "Where's Madam? "
Rong Ci returned home, ate something, packed his computer and some necessities, and was just about to report to the company when the doorbell rang.
Rong Ci glanced at the surveillance camera at the door. It was his neighbor Mrs. Fang and her daughter Tiantian.
Mrs. Fang looked anxious: "Miss Rong, Tiantian's grandma is sick, and I have to take her to the hospital. Can you help me take Tiantian to school? "
Feng Jingxin, Tiantian and the others happened to go to a kindergarten and a company, so Rong Ci agreed.
Twenty minutes later, they arrived near the entrance of the kindergarten. Rong Ci was looking for a place to park when he saw Feng Tingshen, Lin Wu and Feng Jingxin.
Feng Jingxin seemed to be in good spirits. She and Lin Wu were holding hands and jumping up and down as they walked. They looked very happy.
As for Feng Tingshen, he stood next to Lin Wu and considerately blocked the flow of traffic and people for Lin Wu and Feng Jingxin.
Tiantian also saw Feng Jingxin: "Sister Rong, she is Xinxin's classmate! "
"Who is that beautiful aunt holding Xinxin's classmate? Is she also the mother of classmate Xinxin? Does classmate Xinxin have two mothers? "
